notes.title: Bringing Order to PAX East 2025 – More Officials Enlisted to Serve the Nation!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850583/206d576caec76ab39ea27914333513001054209a.png"]

Welcome back, Officer! 
On May 8-11, we were visiting PAX East for the first time, showcasing the demo of Compensation Not Guaranteed. Many people are interested in becoming a newly appointed officer.

We're grateful for our first offline showcase of the year at PAX East 2025, which gathered more audience than we ever expected. Compensation Not Guaranteed wasn’t a game people expected to be published under Toge Productions, and it quickly captured the attention and curiosity of our fans at PAX. They were delighted to discover it among the various indie games being showcased at the booth.

Here's the list of upcoming games we showcased for PAX East 2025
ːsteamthisː Compensation not Guaranteed
ːsteamthisː Kriegsfront Tactics 
ːsteamthisː Whisper Mountain Outbreak 
ːsteamthisː Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville
ːsteamthisː Undusted: Letters from the Past

The Toge crews flew from Indonesia to Boston to help with organizing the booth. Not to mention, our incredible community volunteers from various parts of the United States were also present to lend a hand. With the demo released just last month, people were eager to play it and meet some of the game's quirky characters. Many instantly fell in love with the experience and left ready to become the next recruit to help serve the country better!

Check out the short recap we made for all the games we showcased at PAX East 2025!

notes.title: Compensation Not Guaranteed Demo is Now Available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850583/f361eaba21a65191fc5fe5ac1432531426634b6c.png

When a new nation is born, the help of the people is needed!

Welcome to the office. It's your first day at the job!
Serve your country as a government officer tasked with compensating the land of the people. As you learn the job on the fly, you must authenticate the documents and compensate the people - if they are true to their words! Not everyone is friendly and wants to cooperate. You need to be firm (or lenient) with them while maintaining the goal of restructuring the country! 

You must let every citizen receive fair treatment. 

Learn the factional politics of surrealist post-colonial Southeast Asia, where many tensions arise between the people and the country. Accompanied by hand-drawn anthropomorphic characters, learn the stories of different lives and how you will act around them. Your decision to compensate the people will affect the progress of the story. 

The Demo is Available Now for Free!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795590/Compensation_Not_Guaranteed/

The demo is out as we celebrate LudoNarraCon 2025!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850583/d828c7ba410a84807c7334a50f86b29c2a9a990e.jpg
Toge Productions is participating in LudoNarraCon 2025, where we are also celebrating the demo's release for Compensation of Guaranteed. We thank Fellow Traveller for celebrating this annual event where narrative video games have the chance to showcase the best of their worlds. The event is always well-received by the community, creators, and indie developers worldwide. 

LudoNarraCon 2025 Steam Page

Join the fun for its seventh year from May 1 - 5! Check out the fantastic selection of narrative games, game sales plus demos, and panels from different game creators and media during LudoNarraCon! 


Please look forward to upcoming news from the office.

Sincerely,

notes.title: Compensation Not Guaranteed: Build a Livable Future Together. Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850583/b5c19279c23e274ef11d966c5d226d182931c23b.png

Welcome to the office administration of a better tomorrow!

Compensation not Guaranteed is a new title from Team Project Lunch, an indie developer studio based in Singapore. Become a government official of a new nation under rapid development after its independence, a fictional nation inspired by 1970s Singapore. To develop a better tomorrow, the nation needs its citizens to give up their land since they are the only ones who know how to use it properly. 

Check documents, decide, and compensate (if eligible) 
The citizens are set to comply with the new government order to give their land so the country can thrive. They will come to the government office with their respective documents to inquire about their land. And it's your job to check their documents are in order, and to see if they are eligible for compensation. 

We are the government of free corruption based on professionalism and service. You must follow the rules and procedures to check all the documents properly. Strict conduct must be followed because not every citizen is who they say they are. You might be deceived, and your morals will be questioned.

But still, will you help the country build our children's future? 

Watch the reveal trailer here![previewyoutube=bFaTeWy9Z5A;full][/previewyoutube]

Encounter diverse casts of kooky, anthropomorphic characters with their stories and stakes. Be sure to help the nation develop while maintaining the citizens' approval. As a newly appointed officeholder, you must know when sacrifices must be made, all in the name of progress. And you should be proud of your vital role in our country's future. 

We proudly announce that Compensation not Guaranteed is published under Toge Productions. Hance was revealed for the first time during the 16th Toge Productions Anniversary. We hope to bring amazing and enjoyable games for everyone to play. You can browse more about the Toge Productions' Anniversary event here!
